name: Mumbai University REV-2019 'C' Scheme
description: Mumbai University Revised 2019 'C' Scheme (CBCS) — 20 marks IA + 80 marks ESE, 6 units

in_semester.name: Internal Assessment (IA)
in_semester.notes: IA consists of two class tests (best of 2) and assignment/project work.

instructions: Attempt any THREE from Q.2 to Q.6 (or equivalent structure depending on subject).
In OR_PAIRS pattern: Answer Q.1 or Q.2, Q.3 or Q.4, Q.5 or Q.6.
Neat diagrams must be drawn wherever necessary.
Figures to the right indicate full marks.

question_structure.description: Six units covered through 3 OR-pairs (Q1/Q2, Q3/Q4, Q5/Q6) or a mix of compulsory + choice. Common pattern: Q1 compulsory (covering multiple units), then 3 out of 5 remaining. For engineering: 3 OR-pairs covering 6 units.
